credits.overview: Fifteen years after Pooh, Tigger, and Rabbit are captured and turned into attractions for the sinister Woozles Circus, orphaned teenager Momo Milne begins searching for her missing mother. credits.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
credits.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

credits.title: Bambi: The Reckoning
credits.overview: After a mother and son get in a car wreck, they soon become hunted by Bambi, a mutated grief-stricken deer on a deadly rampage seeking revenge for the death of his mother and wife.

credits.title: Peter Pan's Neverland Nightmare
credits.overview: Wendy Darling strikes out in an attempt to rescue her brother Michael from the clutches of the evil Peter Pan who intends to send him to Neverland. Along the way she meets a twisted Tinkerbell, who is hooked on what she thinks is fairy dust.

credits.title: Christmas with the Princess
credits.overview: After learning she has been dating a prince, she must now be trained to become a princess by the royals. Can she go from rags to riches?

credits.title: The Deadly Swarm
credits.overview: A group of friends, in dire need of cash, find themselves at a secluded medical trial retreat in what seems like an easy way to earn money but quickly turns into their worst nightmare. Under the guise of a harmless experiment run by the enigmatic Dr. Feldman, they are about to face a horror they never imagined. Unbekno

credits.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey 2
credits.overview: Five months following the murders, Christopher Robin struggles to maintain a regular life while dealing with PTSD. However, deep within the 100-Acre-Wood, a destructive rage grows as Pooh, Piglet, Owl, and Tigger find their home and their lives endangered after their existence is revealed.

credits.title: Crocodile Swarm
credits.overview: A group who break into and old mining cave system soon realise a nest of Crocodiles inhabit the caves.

credits.title: Dinosaur Hotel 3
credits.overview: A group of people with dodgy backgrounds wake up in a hotel infested with dinosaurs and soon discover they must play the games to survive the night.

credits.title: Sky Monster
credits.overview: Cindy gets a dream gift for her 21st birthday. She and her friends hop aboard a private jet, heading to a party island. Enroute they find themselves drawn into a storm formation and trapped inside. There is more in this storm than thunder and lightning though, a giant sky Kraken!

credits.title: Dinosaur Prison
credits.overview: A group of people find themselves trapped in a prison facility used to contain prehistoric creatures. Knowing that they could become the deadly dinosaurs' dinner at any time, they must find a way out before they become extinct.

credits.title: Snake Hotel
credits.overview: A group of female inmates wanting to shorten their prison sentences take part in a hellish game of cat and mouse with a giant mutated snake.

credits.title: Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey
credits.overview: After Christopher Robin abandons them for college, Pooh and Piglet embark on a bloody rampage as they search for a new source of food.

credits.title: Firenado
credits.overview: An accountant for the mob, has to escape a whirlwind of fire while is chased by armed robbers.

credits.title: Easter Bunny Massacre: The Bloody Trail
credits.overview: A group of old school friends are reunited for Easter where they are confronted about a crime they committed by a serial killer dressed in a Easter Bunny outfit

credits.title: Mega Lightning
credits.overview: After a violent thunderstorm scares a house party, the guests flee to a nearby home for shelter.. only to discover, a more sinister hand is at play.. Now, they can't escape the strangers home due to the thunderstorm, but they can't stay inside due to the danger that follows them.

credits.title: Bloody Mary Returns
credits.overview: A group of vloggers are looking for the ultimate urban legend and soon discover the legend of Bloody Mary is very much real. Now, the group is stuck under her curse and will have to learn how to stop Bloody Mary once and for all before it's too late.

credits.title: Dinosaur Hotel II
credits.overview: Surviving contestants are reunited in the ultimate game to win 10 million dollars. Only one contestant will survive and claim the prize as the others fall to the dinosaurs.

credits.title: The Killing Tree
credits.overview: On Christmas Eve, a scorned widow casts an ancient spell to resurrect her executed husband. However, when the spell goes wrong, the husband is brought back as an Evil Christmas Tree. Hell-bent on getting revenge on the one who caused his execution, the body count keeps rising as the Tree hunts her down.

credits.title: The Area 51 Incident
credits.overview: An outbreak occurs in the infamous Area 51 leading a group of survivors to an underground bunker.. only to learn.. they are not alone.

credits.title: Pterodactyl
credits.overview: After Lynn goes missing, her younger sister travels to the mountains with her friends to find answers, only to confront the horrors awaiting.

credits.title: Jack Frost
credits.overview: A supernatural creature will stop at nothing in order to turn a family's whole world upside with his icy mayhem.

credits.title: Kingdom of the Dinosaurs
credits.overview: In 2030 during World War III, a small group of survivors make it into a bunker. Two years later they have to exit to find new supplies, but they are greeted by dinosaur predators.

credits.title: Shockwaves
credits.overview: An earthquake has hit the city and a family must seek refuge before its too late.

credits.title: Dragon Fury: Wrath Of Fire
credits.overview: After surviving the events of the first movie, Vanessa has gone into hiding after being threatened by the government. However, a group of researchers find her and soon convince her to go back to the mountains, and this time, the dragons are more deadly than ever.

credits.title: Croc!
credits.overview: Deep in the English countryside, Lisa and Charlie prepare for their wedding at a Tudor mansion. But an angry crocodile lies in wait, determined to ruin their big day.

credits.title: Krampus: The Return
credits.overview: After Lisa's brother mysteriously dies, she and her college friends go to her family home for answers. They are shocked to discover that his killer was non-other than the Christmas demon, Krampus.

credits.title: Wrath of Van Helsing
credits.overview: Van Helsing is called upon to help save a missing girl and her friends from a hoard of demons.

credits.title: Looks Can Kill
credits.overview: A group of models is killed off, one by one, and everyone is a suspect.

credits.title: Monster Portal
credits.overview: A young woman inherits her estranged father's estate after his mysterious death. Once she and her friends arrive at the mansion, they discover that the home is on an old cemetery, which has the power of opening a portal to another realm, which contains the creatures foretold to the world by writer H.P. Lovecraft.

credits.title: Summoning Bloody Mary
credits.overview: A group of friends reuniting soon learn the deadly curse of - The Bloody Mary.

credits.title: Easter Bunny Massacre
credits.overview: A group of friends hiding a deadly secret are hunted down one by one by a bunny masked killer.

credits.title: Spider in the Attic
credits.overview: A deadly nest of spiders lurk in the attic - And the nest is about to be awoken by a news reporter and her colleagues

credits.title: Jack and Jill
credits.overview: A horror retelling of the nursery rhyme Jack and Jill. A group of friends grieving a recent loss meet up with one another only to discover they are being hunted by Jack and Jill.

credits.title: Monsters of War
credits.overview: Something has awoken, and a group of strangers must work together before prehistoric monsters and other deadly creatures take back the planet.

credits.title: Dragon Fury
credits.overview: A group of soldiers are taken to the mountains of Wales to investigate a strange looking monster.

credits.title: Dinosaur Hotel
credits.overview: Sienna is desperate to win a large cash prize in a secret underground game show. However, Dinosaur's begin to hunt her down for the entertainment of the rich and wealthy. Can she be the last to survive the horrific night to win the prize?

credits.title: Go Viral
credits.overview: A harrowing story about a young man who exposes his body one night on a chat room to a beautiful girl. Things take a dramatic turn a year later when the 'beautiful girl' returns.
